item.title: Hephaestus, Amani will crown royalty Saturday
item.description: Tramol Creations King Amani XXVI Anthony Skinner and Queen Amani XXVI Tempest Darnell Jackson were crowned at the 2025 Amani ball in Patterson. The 2026 royals will be crowned Saturday in Patterson. Brocato Photography John Barrett Hover and Lucy Hamer were crowned King and Queen Hephaestus LXV at the 2025 Krewe of Hephaestus ball. Their successors will be crowned Saturday in Morgan City. As the East St. Mary Mardi Gras ball season comes to an end, the parades are just getting started.
